name: hdkicks
description: Pulls a Kick channel's profile picture and banner at the highest resolution Kick's public API actually has — and lets you preview, convert, copy, share, or download them. Nothing resized, nothing re-encoded unless you ask for it.

paragraphs: Pulls a Kick channel's profile picture and banner at the highest resolution Kick's public API actually has — and lets you preview, convert, copy, share, or download them. Nothing resized, nothing re-encoded unless you ask for it.
features: Highest-resolution avatar and banner — picks the best variant by real image dimensions, not by URL guessing alone.
Channel info — follower count (compact, e.g. 1,2 Mn) and Kick's verified-streamer badge, shown next to the handle.

Upscale modes — Original (untouched), Clean ×2 (Lanczos only, colors untouched) and Strong ×4 (staged Lanczos + luma-only, thresholded sharpening so skin and flat areas aren't amplified). All client-side.
Username fallback — Kick slugs use - while usernames can contain ; if a name isn't found, the opposite separator is tried automatically.
Format conversion — Original / PNG / JPEG / WEBP, done client-side with canvas (Firefox-safe: skips canvas if the blob already matches the target type).

whatItDoes.text: Pulls a Kick channel's profile picture and banner at the highest resolution Kick's public API actually has — and lets you preview, convert, copy, share, or download them. Nothing resized, nothing re-encoded unless you ask for it.

requirements.text: No analytics, no trackers, no cookies, no accounts.
